component.name: OPTIBubble
component.summary: Local optical-mark reader — scan paper sheets with your phone

description.p: OPTIBubble turns your computer into a local optical mark reader. Print the answer sheets, photograph them with any phone browser over your own Wi-Fi, and see the results on your computer — in milliseconds, with zero cloud involvement. No cloud, no account, nothing to install on the phone.

It reads filled bubbles reliably, flags ambiguous marks (blank, double-marked, faint) for review with cropped evidence images, and exports verified results to CSV instantly. A4 and US Letter are both supported, from 2 to 102 questions. 100% local: everything runs on your machine.
General-user release: rebuilt web UI, three-pass mark detection, auto-heal for bad scans, HTTPS bridge, and offline Flatpak packaging.
